name: Dragonborn Defiler
tactics: A dragonborn defiler rules through fear and raw arcane might, expecting lackeys to put themselves between it and its enemies. It readily includes allies within the area of defiling breath to extend the duration of its attack and damage bonuses. Although its powers can benefit its followers, the defiler uses them only when it stands to gain.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: psychic damage. Until the end of the defiler’s next turn, the target takes 5 psychic damage each time it damages the defiler or any of the defiler’s allies.

powers.name: Defiling Breath
powers.usageDetails: if the power misses every target

hit.description: cold and necrotic damage, and ongoing 10 cold and necrotic damage (save ends). The defiler gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and a +5 bonus to damage rolls until no creatures are affected by this power.

effect.description: Each ally within 5 squares of the defiler can fly 5 squares as an immediate reaction. The defiler then flies 10 squares. It does not provoke opportunity attacks for leaving the first square during this movement.
